  slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE,

  logo_url text,
  brand_color text NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1',
  tagline text,
  about text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

);

ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config ADD CONSTRAINT career_page_slug_format
  CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]{1,58}[a-z0-9]$');

-- Brand color must be valid hex
ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config ADD CONSTRAINT career_page_brand_color_format

## Section 4: Public RPC — get_career_page

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_career_page(p_slug text)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _config record;
  _jobs jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Get career page config
  SELECT id, team_id, slug, company_name, logo_url, brand_color, tagline, about
  INTO _config
  FROM public.career_page_config
  WHERE slug = p_slug AND is_active = true;

  IF _config IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  -- Get published jobs for this team
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', j.id,
      'title', j.title,
      'location', j.location,
      'department', j.department,
      'employment_type', j.employment_type,
      'salary_range', j.salary_range,
      'created_at', j.created_at
    ) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _jobs
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.team_id = _config.team_id
    AND j.is_published = true
    AND j.status != 'failed';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'config', jsonb_build_object(
      'company_name', _config.company_name,
      'logo_url', _config.logo_url,
      'brand_color', _config.brand_color,
      'tagline', _config.tagline,
      'about', _config.about
    ),
    'jobs', _jobs
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_career_page(text) TO anon, authenticated;
```

## Section 5: Slug Availability RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(p_slug text, p_team_id uuid DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.career_page_config
    WHERE slug = p_slug
      AND (p_team_id IS NULL OR team_id != p_team_id)
  );
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(text, uuid) TO authenticated;
```

131	-- 7. UPDATE handle_new_user() — add team provisioning
132	--    Preserves all existing inbox/profile logic; adds:

135	--      c) auto-accept pending invitations for this email
136	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
137	
138	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
139	  RETURNS trigger
140	  LANGUAGE plpgsql
141	  SECURITY DEFINER
142	  SET search_path TO 'public'
143	AS $function$
144	DECLARE
145	  raw_email   text;
146	  local_part  text;
147	  domain      text;
148	  base_inbox  text;
149	  final_inbox text;
150	  suffix      text;
151	  attempts    int := 0;
152	  new_team_id uuid;
153	  user_name   text;
154	BEGIN
155	  -- ── Profile & inbox (existing logic) ──────────────────────
156	  raw_email := lower(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'email'));
157	  IF raw_email IS NULL OR raw_email = '' THEN
158	    raw_email := lower(trim(NEW.email));
159	  END IF;
160	
161	  SELECT inbound_email_domain INTO domain FROM public.platform_config LIMIT 1;
162	  IF domain IS NULL OR domain = '' THEN
163	    domain := 'inbound.rankora.co';
164	  END IF;
165	
166	  local_part := split_part(raw_email, '@', 1);
167	  local_part := regexp_replace(local_part, '[^a-z0-9.\-]', '.', 'g');
168	  local_part := regexp_replace(local_part, '\.{2,}', '.', 'g');
169	  local_part := trim(both '.' from local_part);
170	  IF local_part = '' THEN local_part := 'user'; END IF;
171	
172	  base_inbox  := local_part || '@' || domain;
173	  final_inbox := base_inbox;
174	
175	  WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE inbox_email = final_inbox) LOOP
176	    attempts := attempts + 1;
177	    suffix := substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 3);
178	    final_inbox := local_part || '.' || suffix || '@' || domain;
179	    IF attempts > 10 THEN
180	      final_inbox := substr(md5(NEW.id::text || now()::text), 1, 12) || '@' || domain;
181	      EXIT;
182	    END IF;
183	  END LOOP;
184	
185	  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, credits, inbox_email)
186	  VALUES (NEW.id, 5, final_inbox);
187	
188	  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role)
189	  VALUES (NEW.id, 'user');
190	
191	  -- ── Team provisioning (new) ────────────────────────────────
192	  user_name := COALESCE(
193	    NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''),
194	    NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name'), ''),
195	    local_part
196	  );
197	
198	  INSERT INTO public.teams (name, owner_id)
199	  VALUES (user_name || '''s Team', NEW.id)
200	  RETURNING id INTO new_team_id;
201	
202	  INSERT INTO public.team_members (team_id, user_id, role)
203	  VALUES (new_team_id, NEW.id, 'owner');
204	
205	  -- ── Auto-accept pending invitations for this email ─────────
206	  -- Update team_invitations status and insert team_members rows
207	  -- for any pending, non-expired invitations addressed to this email.
208	  INSERT INTO public.team_members (team_id, user_id, role)
209	  SELECT ti.team_id, NEW.id, ti.role
210	  FROM public.team_invitations ti
211	  WHERE lower(ti.email) = lower(raw_email)
212	    AND ti.status = 'pending'
213	    AND ti.expires_at > now()
214	  ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
215	
216	  UPDATE public.team_invitations
217	  SET status = 'accepted'
218	  WHERE lower(email) = lower(raw_email)
219	    AND status = 'pending'
220	    AND expires_at > now();
221	
222	  RETURN NEW;
223	END;
224	$function$;

-- ============================================================
-- CAREER PAGE FEATURE
-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:
--   • public.teams                         (20260407100000)
--   • public.jobs                          (initial schema + 20260407100000)
--   • public.is_team_admin()               (20260407100000)
--   • public.update_updated_at_column()    (initial schema)
-- ============================================================


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. career_page_config TABLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.career_page_config (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE,
  slug         text        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  company_name text        NOT NULL,
  logo_url     text,
  brand_color  text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1',
  tagline      text,
  about        text,
  is_active    boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Slug validation: lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, 3-60 chars,
-- must start and end with alphanumeric character
ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config
  ADD CONSTRAINT career_page_slug_format
  CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]{1,58}[a-z0-9]$');

-- Brand color must be a valid 6-digit hex color
ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config
  ADD CONSTRAINT career_page_brand_color_format
  CHECK (brand_color ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$');

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_career_page_slug   ON public.career_page_config(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_career_page_team   ON public.career_page_config(team_id);

-- updated_at trigger (reuses existing function from initial schema)
CREATE TRIGGER update_career_page_config_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.career_page_config
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. EXTEND jobs TABLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location        text;
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS department      text;
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS employment_type text DEFAULT 'Full-time';
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS salary_range    text;
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_published    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- Index to efficiently query published jobs by team
CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_is_published_team
  ON public.jobs(team_id, is_published)
  WHERE is_published = true;


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. RLS FOR career_page_config
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Public (anon + authenticated) can view ACTIVE career pages
-- Used by the public /careers/:slug route
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view active career pages"
  ON public.career_page_config FOR SELECT
  TO anon, authenticated
  USING (is_active = true);

-- Team admins can view their own config regardless of is_active
-- Required for the settings/management page
CREATE POLICY "Team admins can view own career config"
  ON public.career_page_config FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Team admins can create a career page config for their team
CREATE POLICY "Team admins can manage career config"
  ON public.career_page_config FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Team admins can update their team's career page config
CREATE POLICY "Team admins can update career config"
  ON public.career_page_config FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Team admins can delete their team's career page config
CREATE POLICY "Team admins can delete career config"
  ON public.career_page_config FOR DELETE
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. PUBLIC RPC — get_career_page
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns the career page config + published jobs for a given slug.
-- SECURITY DEFINER so it can bypass RLS to read jobs/config
-- for the unauthenticated public careers page.
-- search_path is pinned to prevent search_path injection.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_career_page(p_slug text)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _config record;
  _jobs   jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Fetch career page config (active only — public endpoint)
  SELECT id, team_id, slug, company_name, logo_url, brand_color, tagline, about
  INTO   _config
  FROM   public.career_page_config
  WHERE  slug = p_slug
    AND  is_active = true;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  -- Fetch published, non-failed jobs for this team
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',              j.id,
        'title',           j.title,
        'location',        j.location,
        'department',      j.department,
        'employment_type', j.employment_type,
        'salary_range',    j.salary_range,
        'created_at',      j.created_at
      ) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO _jobs
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.team_id     = _config.team_id
    AND j.is_published = true
    AND j.status      != 'failed';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'config', jsonb_build_object(
      'company_name', _config.company_name,
      'logo_url',     _config.logo_url,
      'brand_color',  _config.brand_color,
      'tagline',      _config.tagline,
      'about',        _config.about
    ),
    'jobs', _jobs
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_career_page(text) TO anon, authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.get_career_page(text) IS
  'Public RPC: returns career page config + published jobs for a slug. Safe for unauthenticated callers — only exposes active pages and published jobs.';


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 5. SLUG AVAILABILITY RPC — is_career_slug_available
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns true if p_slug is not taken by any team other than
-- p_team_id (pass p_team_id when checking for an existing team
-- updating its own slug).
-- Authenticated-only — slug availability is not public API.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(
  p_slug    text,
  p_team_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.career_page_config
    WHERE slug = p_slug
      AND (p_team_id IS NULL OR team_id != p_team_id)
  );
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(text, uuid) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(text, uuid) IS
  'Returns true if the slug is not already taken by another team. Pass p_team_id to exclude the callers own team (for update-slug flows).';


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 6. TABLE COMMENT
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

COMMENT ON TABLE public.career_page_config IS
  'One career page config per team. Slug drives the public /careers/:slug route. is_active must be true for the page to be publicly visible.';
